fields.rationale: “at no point in the infinite past could we find the man counting down” argues that completing a beginningless countdown produces a contradiction. This supports the pro subsidiary bridge that such a temporal series cannot be completed; it does not attack the con bridge defending that possibility.

“it will either happen from eternity or not at all” rejects the proposed impersonal indeterministic origin by arguing that a metastable impersonal cause cannot explain a temporally first universe. This attacks the con subsidiary bridge; it does not establish the complete motion-level conclusion.
